name: feather
description: feather monorepo：engine（主线程）+ shell（Worker）+ 共享 @box vendor

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @feather/protocol typecheck && pnpm --filter @feather/transport typecheck && pnpm --filter feather-shell typecheck && pnpm --filter feather-engine typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @feather/protocol build && pnpm --filter @feather/transport build && pnpm --filter feather-shell build && pnpm --filter feather-engine build
